packs.description: Mixamo "Male Locomotion": idle, walk, run, strafes, turns and a jump
Mixamo farming: carrying a box, holding, wheelbarrow, planting, watering, picking, milking
Mixamo "Male Injured": injured walk and run in every direction, idles, turns and jumps
Mixamo "Pro Magic": standing and crouched locomotion, magic attacks and casts, blocking, hit reactions, deaths, jumps
Mixamo "Longbow Aiming": aim idle, aim walk in four directions, draw, overdraw and recoil
Mixamo "Sword and Shield": locomotion, slashes, attacks, blocks, impacts, crouch, casting, deaths, sheathing
clips: sword and shield crouch block idle
